title: Smashed Chickpea Buddha Bowl
description: Smashed spiced chickpeas over quinoa with roasted sweet potato, avocado and a tahini dressing.
ingredients: 1 small sweet potato, roasted and cubed
steps: Roughly smash the chickpeas with a fork and season well.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and a little water into a dressing.
Build the bowl with quinoa, sweet potato, chickpeas and avocado, then drizzle with dressing.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste chickpea smash bowls

notes: Smashing rather than blending the chickpeas keeps some texture — more satisfying to eat than a puree.
